versions.content: If the DemFreezeFrameRecordTrigger is set to DEM_- TRIGGER_ON_FDC_THRESHOLD and the event reports DEM_EVENT_STATUS_FDC_- THRESHOLD_REACHED (monitor-internal debounced event), the FreezeFrame shall be captured (refer [SWS_Dem_00797]), but at most once per operation cycle.
